settings.name: TRADELOCKER_EMAIL
settings.purpose: The email you sign in to TradeLocker with.

settings.name: TRADELOCKER_SERVER
settings.purpose: The server name shown on the TradeLocker login screen (e.g. GATESFX).

settings.name: TRADELOCKER_ACC_ID
settings.purpose: The account number shown after the '#' in the account switcher.

settings.name: TRADELOCKER_URL
settings.purpose: The DEMO API endpoint. Defaults to the demo host; a live URL is refused.

settings.name: DATABASE_URL
settings.purpose: PostgreSQL. WITHOUT THIS the kill switch, daily-loss counter and drawdown state reset on every redeploy, because the filesystem is ephemeral. Add a PostgreSQL plugin and this is set for you.

settings.name: DASHBOARD_TOKEN
settings.purpose: Protects the pause, kill-switch and manual-scan controls. Any long random string.

settings.name: TRADED_SYMBOLS
settings.purpose: Which pairs to scan. Accepts bare pairs (EURUSD) or your broker's exact names (EURUSD.R) — both resolve.

settings.name: TRADING_MODE
settings.purpose: 'paper' simulates fills against live prices and sends nothing to the broker (the default). 'demo_live' places real orders on the DEMO account.

settings.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
settings.purpose: Optional AI review. AI can only VETO a trade, never create or change one. Leave blank to run fully deterministically.

settings.name: GROQ_API_KEY
settings.purpose: Optional AI review fallback. Same veto-only role.

warnings: No DATABASE_URL: risk state (kill switch, daily loss, drawdown, losing streak) will reset on every redeploy. Add a PostgreSQL plugin before trading for real.

No DASHBOARD_TOKEN: the controls that can START trading — clearing the kill switch, resuming the scanner, switching strategy, running a manual scan — are DISABLED, because this deployment is reachable by anyone who learns its hostname and hostnames are published in certificate transparency logs. Stopping the bot still works without it. Set DASHBOARD_TOKEN to any long random string, then unlock the dashboard with the same value.
pasteBlock:
TRADELOCKER_EMAIL=your@email.com
TRADELOCKER_PASSWORD=
TRADELOCKER_SERVER=
TRADELOCKER_ACC_ID=
TRADELOCKER_URL=https://demo.tradelocker.com/backend-api
DASHBOARD_TOKEN=
TRADED_SYMBOLS=EURUSD,GBPUSD,USDJPY,AUDUSD,USDCHF,XAUUSD
TRADING_MODE=paper
